messages:
marco-ops: hey @people-ops — quick question: I was on an unpaid LOA from 2025-12-18 to 2026-01-05 and couldn't use 8h of carryover before the year-end blackout. Payroll cutoff was 2025-12-20. Is there an exception to either cash out or carry the hours forward? also, can i swap one banked holiday into PTO this quarter to cover a day?

laura-peopleops: hi Marco — thanks for flagging. We can usually only carry over unused PTO per the annual carryover policy, but LOAs are special. Do you have the LOA approval date? If LOA started after the blackout/payroll cutoff we may be able to make an exception. cc @sanjay-hr for payroll

marco-ops: LOA approval email timestamp is 2025-12-19 10:34 PST (manager approved). I used MyPortal to request but couldn't schedule time before shutdown.

sanjay-hr: quick note: payroll cutoff 12/20 means any payout would need a retro adjustment. We can do a one-time exception for carryover extension if People Ops approves and Finance OKs the retro. I'll need LOA approval screenshot and manager signoff in the HR portal. Fund coding will be the same as your original accrual bucket.

jenna-manager: i approved Marco's LOA on 12/19. happy to sign the form — @laura-peopleops can you point me to the approval checkbox you need? :+1:

laura-peopleops: thanks Jenna. Marco — please attach the LOA approval email and add a short note in the HR form (reason: LOA overlapped blackout). I'll route to Finance for retro payout or extended carryover. If Finance declines payout we offer extension to use the 8 hrs through Q2 2026.

hr-bot: Automated link: PTO policy (carryover & LOA exceptions) https://redwood/hr/policies/pto#loa-exceptions — form: https://redwood/hr/forms/pto-exception

marco-ops: got it — filing now and pinging you both. if we go extension, can i convert a banked holiday (2026-04-02) to cover the missed day instead? that's preferable.

sanjay-hr: conversion is allowed but requires manager + people-ops signoff. If you choose conversion we'll log it as a swap (banked->regular PTO) and no retro is needed.

laura-peopleops: yes conversion path is cleaner. mention "banked holiday swap for LOA carryover" in the form and Jenna can approve. i'll confirm with Finance once form is in.

marco-ops: thanks all — filing form now. will update once submitted :)
